Any later read’s three-replica query intersects that set, so its selected tag cannot be smaller. This holds with concurrent readers: write-backs of older tags never overwrite newer tags, and overlapping reads may be ordered by their selected tags.

This ordering respects real time: completed write-before-read and read-before-read relations follow from quorum intersection; a read completed before a later write’s invocation has a smaller tag because the writer is sequential; write-before-write relations follow from that same writer ordering.
